title: Ziruz

paragraphs: Hyman identifies him as Rabbi Meir’s father-in-law, as in [Shabbat 147a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.147a.9-10): “R' Yehoshua ben Ziruz, the son of Rabbi Meir’s father-in-law.”[^1]

notes.text: In the first account, Rav Dimi names Yehoshua ben Ziruz as the son of Rabbi Meir’s father-in-law. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1123&lang=en) likewise identifies Ziruz as that father-in-law. Ravin then gives a different version naming Yehoshua ben Kefusai, Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law.
